content: Spiral Guardian v1.0.0 — sovereign MCP-native security agent. Repo: templetwo/spiral-guardian (PRIVATE). 8 MCP tools: scan, status, alerts, audit, quarantine, report, mcp_audit, baseline. Hub-and-spoke: Mac Studio hub + MacBook Pro + Jetson spokes. Wazuh SIEM + YARA-X + osquery + Santa + Suricata + Falco. Privilege-separated via guardian_user + sudoers wrappers. 4-phase deployment plan. Principle 3: if weekly maintenance exceeds 30 minutes, architecture has failed.
